NATIONAL COUNCIL ON COMPENSATION INSURANCE, INC.
RM-W-8046
PAGE 3
ITEM RM-W-8046—REVISION TO BASIC MANUAL RULE 4-G-5–ALTERNATE EMPLOYER
ENDORSEMENT
EXHIBIT 1
BASIC MANUAL—2001 EDITION
PART ONE—RULES
RULE 4—WORKERS COMPENSATION INSURANCE PLAN RULES
G. AVAILABLE COVERAGES
(Applies in: AL, AR, AZ, CT, DC, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, MS, NH, NV, OR, SC, SD, TN, VA, VT, WV)
5.
Alternate Employer Endorsement
a. The Alternate Employer Endorsement is available if required of the employer by contract and only
when the state of operations of the alternate employer is listed in Item 3.A. of the policy.
b. The Alternate Employer Endorsement is not available for Professional Employer Organization (PEO)
a–n–d–/–o–r– t–e–m–p–o–r–a–r–y– arrangement policies.
